title: text_documents_v2

shot_ids.description: Comma-separated shot_id list covering [start_sec, end_sec]; may be empty when no shot overlaps.

keyframe_id.description: Set for ocr, caption, visible_text; null for asr and scene.

description: Global text-search rows. asr rows are 10-30 s chunks; ocr rows are one keyframe's lines joined; caption and visible_text come from the caption pass; scene rows are scene summaries (ADR 0026). text_vectors.npy row i is the E5 vector of row i.
